# Maxey0 Context plane

Governed context and execution for agents: an explicit SCW address space, a gate at every tool call and every model egress, and a hash-chained record of both.

**Installs from this repository.**

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add mmc7676/Maxey0
/plugin install maxey0-context@maxey0
```

The window and the only writer of it, installable alone. No loop library and no Gate.

## What this is

- `plugins/maxey0-context/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`

- product `Maxey0-SuperSpace`
- MCP namespace `maxey0-ss` — every tool and resource
